przepis.opis_efektu: A 2×2 grid of result cards appears in the center of the frame. Cards auto-swap every 1 second: each card flips or slides to reveal a new result. Bold metric at top (number or short phrase), brief context label below. All 4 cards swap independently on staggered timers (card 1 at t=0, card 2 at t=0.25s, card 3 at t=0.5s, card 4 at t=0.75s). White cards, rounded corners, soft shadow. The grid shows 8+ results in rotation over 4–6 seconds. After cycling, can freeze on a final strong set.
